description: Certificate of lawfulness for Proposed Rear Extension, Proposed Side Extension and Proposed Loft Conversion
decision_conditions: The operations do not fall within the provisions of parts (d) & (f) (i) & (j) (iii) and (ja) of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A & A.1 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, as amended. Specifically;

The proposed single storey rear and side extension would be increased in width and joined to an existing side extensions, the cumulative width of which would be more than half of the width of the original dwelling. Also, the proposed extensions would be joined to existing side extensions including alterations to the existing eaves level and roof of the original host dwelling, as result of planning approval ref. 630.81.

The operations do not fall within the provisions of parts (b) & (d) (ii), and (b) (i) (aa) & (bb), and (ii) of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes B.1 and B.2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, as amended. Specifically;

The proposed rear dormer is not permitted development, as this would result in additional roof space that exceeds 50 cubic metres for detached house and would be addition/alteration to the replacement of existing roofs or raised eaves levels of the original host building, as result of planning approval ref. 630.81.
